QuestInfo.name: Chromile's Diary - Part 3
QuestInfo.0: You think there might still be some pages missing from the diary.
QuestInfo.1: You now know the details of the fateful day of the kidnapping, but you still don't know what happened to Chromile after that. Investigate the #b#eDark Axe Stumps#k#n in the #bRugged Rocky Zone#k and see if you can find any more missing pages.

0.0: Neinheart was right. The whole picture tells a different story. But I still have to find my father. Maybe it's not too late to save him from darkness. The monsters around here may still hold some clues.

yes.0: This will be my last search. I'll investigate the #b#eDark Axe Stumps#k#n in the #bRugged Rocky Zone#k to see if there are any diary pages left.

no.0: Maybe it's better to stop here. Maybe the truth is good enough...

1.0:
I'm almost getting used to this writing... 
#b'Day 38
I can't bring the child along anymore. My path is leading me to a dark place, and I don't want my baby to follow. I'm going to a man named Limbert today, and that'll be the last time I see #h0#. I've decided to go into the Sleepywood. This will be the final chronicle of the Knight of Light. Chromile's saga ends here.'

#kThis seems to be the final entry... Did he really go into the Sleepywood?
1.1: Father left for my sake. I'll do my best to make you proud, dad.
